Before any figure in this report was calculated, the NeoIPC validation rules were applied to your department's data.
A record a rule flags is removed from the dataset together with the whole patient record it belongs to — the patient's admissions and forms — unless an exception list names it, and the removed records are not part of any figure in this report.
@tbl-validation-summary shows, for each rule that removed or exempted a record, how many records of which kind it concerned, and the totals across all rules; where the report compares your department with reference data that carry a summary of their own, it is shown alongside.
The Validation Report for your department explains each rule and lists every record a rule flags.

Before the rules are applied, the NeoIPC coordinating centre reconciles two kinds of stored values with what Tracker Capture derives and shows: values it derives itself, which your department does not choose, and infectious agents in a section of a form that it hides.
Of the values Tracker Capture derives, the coordinating centre reconciles the day of life of an infant admitted from the delivery room or on the day of birth, on the admission form and on the infection and procedure forms of that admission, and the total gestation days, which Tracker Capture computes from the gestational age.
@tbl-reconciliation-summary shows how many records of which kind each reconciliation repaired and, where there are any, how many it reported and kept as stored, because a repair would have left a form that does not meet its case definition; reference data that carry a summary of their own are shown alongside.
The Validation Report checks the reconciled values and does not list the reconciliations.
